answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 24 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The mesa register is checked at draw time, sparrow lists the eligible set, and prism seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 24 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary forfeits for every seat it wants. The bill scales 32 fold, not the vote. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
